Economic implications include edge computing demand from AI but capex signaling investments outpacing revenue. Market psychology: Sell the news despite beat, fear of dilution or margin pressure. Historical parallels: Similar to 2021 cloud stock drops post-beat on guidance worries. Analogies: Like a sprinter slowing mid-race (revenue decel); building a Ferrari while sales lag (capex).
